repaired.question: What were all the salary values of players in 2010 and 2001?
repaired.old: SELECT baseball_1_salary FROM baseball_1_salary WHERE YEAR  =  2010 UNION SELECT baseball_1_salary FROM baseball_1_salary WHERE YEAR  =  2001
repaired.new: SELECT salary FROM baseball_1_salary WHERE YEAR = 2010 UNION SELECT salary FROM baseball_1_salary WHERE YEAR = 2001

repaired.question: List the 3 highest salaries of the players in 2001?
repaired.old: SELECT baseball_1_salary FROM baseball_1_salary WHERE YEAR  =  2001 ORDER BY baseball_1_salary DESC LIMIT 3;
repaired.new: SELECT salary FROM baseball_1_salary WHERE YEAR = 2001 ORDER BY salary DESC LIMIT 3

repaired.question: Which team offers the lowest average salary? Give me the name and id of the team.
repaired.old: SELECT T1.name ,  T1.team_id FROM baseball_1_team AS T1 JOIN baseball_1_salary AS T2 ON T1.team_id = T2.team_id GROUP BY T1.team_id ORDER BY avg(T2.baseball_1_salary) ASC LIMIT 1;
repaired.new: SELECT T1.name, T1.team_id FROM baseball_1_team AS T1 JOIN baseball_1_salary AS T2 ON T1.team_id = T2.team_id GROUP BY T1.team_id ORDER BY AVG(T2.salary) ASC LIMIT 1

repaired.question: What is the total salary expenses of team Boston Red Stockings in 2010?
repaired.old: SELECT sum(T1.baseball_1_salary) FROM baseball_1_salary AS T1 JOIN baseball_1_team AS T2 ON T1.team_id  =  T2.team_id_br WHERE T2.name  = 'Boston Red Stockings' AND T1.year  =  2010
repaired.new: SELECT SUM(T1.salary) FROM baseball_1_salary AS T1 JOIN baseball_1_team AS T2 ON T1.team_id = T2.team_id_br WHERE T2.name = 'Boston Red Stockings' AND T1.year = 2010

repaired.question: Compute the average salary of the players in the team called 'Boston Red Stockings'.
repaired.old: SELECT avg(T1.baseball_1_salary) FROM baseball_1_salary AS T1 JOIN baseball_1_team AS T2 ON T1.team_id  =  T2.team_id_br WHERE T2.name  = 'Boston Red Stockings'
repaired.new: SELECT AVG(T1.salary) FROM baseball_1_salary AS T1 JOIN baseball_1_team AS T2 ON T1.team_id = T2.team_id_br WHERE T2.name = 'Boston Red Stockings'

repaired.question: How much salary did the top 3 well-paid players get in 2001?
repaired.old: SELECT baseball_1_salary FROM baseball_1_salary WHERE YEAR  =  2001 ORDER BY baseball_1_salary DESC LIMIT 3;
repaired.new: SELECT salary FROM baseball_1_salary WHERE YEAR = 2001 ORDER BY salary DESC LIMIT 3

repaired.question: For each team, return the team name, id and the maximum salary among the team.
repaired.old: SELECT T1.name ,  T1.team_id ,  max(T2.baseball_1_salary) FROM baseball_1_team AS T1 JOIN baseball_1_salary AS T2 ON T1.team_id  =  T2.team_id GROUP BY T1.team_id;
repaired.new: SELECT T1.name, T1.team_id, MAX(T2.salary) FROM baseball_1_team AS T1 JOIN baseball_1_salary AS T2 ON T1.team_id = T2.team_id GROUP BY T1.team_id

repaired.question: What is the highest salary among each team? List the team name, id and maximum salary.
repaired.old: SELECT T1.name ,  T1.team_id ,  max(T2.baseball_1_salary) FROM baseball_1_team AS T1 JOIN baseball_1_salary AS T2 ON T1.team_id  =  T2.team_id GROUP BY T1.team_id;
repaired.new: SELECT T1.name, T1.team_id, MAX(T2.salary) FROM baseball_1_team AS T1 JOIN baseball_1_salary AS T2 ON T1.team_id = T2.team_id GROUP BY T1.team_id
